# The three skip rules over four weeks. Week 44 opens a pull request for api and web. Week 45 finds the same updates and skips both.
# Week 46 has a new version of the api library, but a bump pull request of the repository is still open, so api skips and no run starts.
# Week 47 has no open pull request any more, and api gets a second pull request. Every skip costs no run, no update agent and no worktree.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
maintinit
maintfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_BASE=file://$WORK/remotes
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W44

exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh
stdout 'item bump-api-2026-W44 finished'
grep -count=2 '^update$' calls.log
grep -count=2 'gh pr create' gh.log

# Rule 2: the fingerprint of the updates is the one of week 44.
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W45
exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh
grep '^2026-W45\tapi\tskipped\t\tskip: same updates as 2026-W44, no new version since\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep '^2026-W45\tweb\tskipped\t\tskip: same updates as 2026-W44, no new version since\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep '^2026-W45\ttools\tskipped\t\tskip: nothing is outdated\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep -count=2 '^update$' calls.log
! exists home/.upkeep/state/tools.env
exec beehave status
! stdout 'bump-api-2026-W45'

# Rule 3: a new version changes the fingerprint, but pull request 5 of the repository is still open.
cp fixtures-new/go-api.json fixtures/go-api.json
cp open-5.txt gh/open
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W46
exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh
grep '^2026-W46\tapi\tskipped\t\tskip: pull request #5 is still open\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep -count=2 '^update$' calls.log
grep -count=2 'gh pr create' gh.log
grep '3 repositories listed. 0 opened a pull request, 3 skipped,' home/.upkeep/reports/2026-W46.md

# The bump pull request is merged or closed. A person's own open pull request (7) is not a bump: api bumps again, on a new branch.
cp open-person.txt gh/open
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W47
exec sh home/.upkeep/scripts/tick.sh
stdout 'item bump-api-2026-W47 finished'
grep '^2026-W47\tapi\topened\thttps://github.example/acme/pull/3\tdraft pull request\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep -count=3 '^update$' calls.log
grep -count=1 'gh pr create --draft --head upkeep/api-2026-W47' gh.log
grep '^last_week=2026-W47$' home/.upkeep/state/api.env
grep '^last_week=2026-W44$' home/.upkeep/state/web.env
exec git -C remotes/acme/api show --stat upkeep/api-2026-W47
stdout 'go.mod'

-- fixtures/go-api.json --
{"Path":"acme/api","Main":true}
{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.2.0","Update":{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.3.0"}}
-- fixtures/go-tools.json --
{"Path":"acme/tools","Main":true}
{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.2.0"}
-- fixtures/npm.json --
{"left-pad":{"current":"1.0.0","wanted":"1.3.0","latest":"1.3.0"}}
-- fixtures-new/go-api.json --
{"Path":"acme/api","Main":true}
{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.2.0","Update":{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.4.0"}}
-- open-5.txt --
7	feature/login
5	upkeep/api-2026-W44
-- open-person.txt --
7	feature/login
-- gh/placeholder --
